svg.text: The city's towers up close: palettes and facade types

Variety by hue and chroma at equal luminance: every pane, fin, spandrel, base and cornice is within 0.04 of its wall, so any two neighbouring elements differ by at most 0.08 of relative luminance (Rendering's contrast budget 0.085; Legal's w05). Concept art, working labels, pending Legal.
today: one grey and one glass, every tower the same grid
proposed: six tints and three facade types, with a lobby storey and a set-back crown
today: one grey and one glass, every tower the same grid
proposed: six tints and three facade types, with a lobby storey and a set-back crown

Facade types: ribbon (bands and thin piers), punched (panes with spandrels: stone and brick), fins (tall glass between projecting fins). Which district takes which is in data/art/city-looks.json "districts". Every tone is within 0.04 of its wall, so any two neighbours are at most 0.08 apart (Legal's w05).
